title: DeltaCodeReviewFindings
description: Output schema for the delta-code-review skill. The skill emits a JSON array of finding objects. Empty array means no findings (clean diff).

file.description: Path to the file relative to repo root, matching the unified-diff `+++ b/<path>` header.

line_range.description: Single line `42` or inclusive range `42-44` referencing line numbers in the new file (post-diff). MUST overlap a `+` or context line in the diff.

severity.description: ASCII three-tier severity. BLOCK = correctness/security/contract — must not merge. SUGGEST = non-blocking quality improvement. NIT = style/idiom/readability. No emoji. No 5-tier scale (CRITICAL/HIGH/etc) — that scale is reserved for the audit (P0-02) skill.

category.description: Fixed taxonomy. `undefined-reference` is the only category permitted when the diff alone cannot resolve a referenced symbol; all other categories require evidence within the diff window.

comment.description: One- or two-sentence explanation of what is wrong and why it matters. No prose padding.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete fix the reviewer would write inline. Code snippet OK; no full-file rewrite. If no fix is feasible without more context, the literal string `n/a — needs broader audit` is acceptable.

examples.comment: Comparator uses `a - b` on string values; string subtraction yields NaN and produces undefined sort order.
New `sortByName` export has no test in the diff. Add a case covering at least the empty-array, single-element, and reversed-input shapes.
Using `for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)` where `i` is unused; `for...of` reads cleaner.
examples.suggested_fix: Replace the index loop with `for (const item of arr) { ... }`.
